items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I didn't get them all. About half of them from New Orleans, you know? Well they were, but I didn't get the, I wasn't that long of a band. I used to go up and hit a band, but I didn't know them enough, you know, to get to know them, you know?

ctx.x: But what about in the clubs? Did they have clubs that used mixed bands?

Not in the clubs so much, no, they didn't use mixed bands in the club, or the ballrooms. Now like I said, there was in the ballroom that had colored bands, they had white bands, but they had some good, like Louis Russell's band and some other colored bands at that time, Louis Russell and oh I can't think of it, Kenny Scott and Pippenow, some others, I can't think of it. Did you know the guys in Louis Russell's band? No, I didn't get them all. About half of them from New Orleans, you know? Well they were, but I…
Did you know, what did Maher's play like is what I'm trying to say?
